evidence_scope: full 2000-session train_explore shared-cohort diagnostic candidate-recall probe; outer-fold and taxonomy views are diagnostics, not private or independent validation

global_incumbent.interpretation: comparable cached nested-OOF incumbent; not a private score; this probe cannot change or evaluate served Top10

prior_candidate_frontier.interpretation: C400 and E0 are implementation/runtime failures with unknown recall, not algorithm No-Go evidence, and are never rerun

pre_preregistration_boundary_event.event: a read-only external hash-location Select-String command was scoped too broadly and necessarily opened files under protected experiment directories
confirmed_returned_paths: seven additional train_explore smoke aggregate paths under the same action_oracle_v1 directory whose basenames were truncated by the shell formatter
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.unknown_access_scope: Select-String may also have opened earlier enumerated nonmatching files before the pipeline stopped at ten matches; OS-level file-open telemetry was not recorded, so the access scope cannot be narrowed after the fact
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.observed_output: only matching file paths were returned; no protected file bytes, labels, metrics, targets, or aggregate values were displayed to or used by the orchestration model
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.timing: before this preregistration, before implementation, before any receipt, and before any v2.19 outcome
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.decision_independence: the sole mechanism below was selected from target-free source, catalog schema, sealed identifier-free visible context, and sealed C200 shape only
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.mitigation: all v2.19 pre-target code uses explicit file allowlists plus protected-path deny checks; no recursive external scan is permitted; the event is retained for audit rather than hidden
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.compliance_status: PRE_PREREG_PROTECTED_PATH_ACCESS_INCIDENT_RECORDED; this is a real violation of the no-old-calibration access rule and is not erased by later isolation
pre_preregistration_boundary_event.formal_result_qualification: a fresh no-history implementation/review agent plus the formal runner must prove zero protected-path access before the durable receipt; that separately qualifies the formal run but must never be represented as making the overall orchestration clean

sole_hypothesis.name: REGISTRY_CATEGORY_AND_CORE_ATTRIBUTE_REWRITE_TAIL
sole_hypothesis.claim: one field-isolated category AND canonical material/style/use-case sparse route can recover targets buried by the flattened broad/strict query without changing the frozen C200 prefix
sole_hypothesis.activation: the current visible goal version has at least one canonical category and at least one active current-version positive material, style, or use_case constraint; otherwise the route is empty
sole_hypothesis.category_terms: canonical category values from build_conversation_constraint_view(category_text, active_terms, excluded_terms), restricted to values represented by the frozen attributes.CATEGORIES registry and expanded only to registry surfaces mapping back to those canonical values; unknown categories do not activate and never fall back to raw terms
sole_hypothesis.attribute_terms: status=active, polarity=+1, record.version=context.version records in exactly material/style/use_case; values are canonicalized by the corresponding frozen SLOT_VOCABULARIES registry and expanded only to registry surfaces mapping back to those canonical values
sole_hypothesis.term_order: canonical plus reverse-registry surfaces, normalized, deduplicated, lexicographically sorted, and truncated to 24 terms independently per clause
sole_hypothesis.query: SELECT rowid,parent_asin FROM products WHERE products MATCH ? ORDER BY bm25(products,0.0,6.0,4.0,2.5,2.5,1.5,1.0),parent_asin ASC LIMIT 120
sole_hypothesis.tail: discard identifiers already in the complete sealed variable-length C200, apply the frozen hard-conflict mask to novel identifiers, preserve remaining route order, then append
sole_hypothesis.candidate_surface: complete sealed ordered variable-length C200 prefix plus the filtered rewrite tail, capped at 400; because the sole route is LIMIT 120, the structural per-turn maximum is 320
sole_hypothesis.fusion: none; there is one new route and no RRF, score fusion, learned weight, or whole-union reranking
sole_hypothesis.served_top10: unchanged and never read from the expanded tail; C200[:10] remains byte-identical
sole_hypothesis.runtime: target-blind, causal, deterministic, local-only, diagnostic-only, default off

hard_conflict_mask.scope: novel rewrite tail only; never filter, reorder, truncate, or reinterpret the sealed C200 prefix
hard_conflict_mask.current_goal_only: only status=active records whose version equals context.version are executable; retired and stale-version records are ignored
hard_conflict_mask.negative: intersect current-version hard negative ledger slot/value pairs with negative constraints reconstructed by build_conversation_constraint_view; accept only frozen P8 slots audience/material/color/closure/style/use_case and single-token canonical values; classify reliable catalog evidence with p8_negative.classify_candidate and drop only EXPLICIT_VIOLATION
hard_conflict_mask.positive: for current-version hard positive records in registry-backed category/audience/material/color/closure/style/use_case/size/width slots, drop only when reliable canonical catalog evidence exists for that slot and is disjoint from every requested value; missing or unrecognized metadata is UNKNOWN and retained
hard_conflict_mask.category: canonical category is treated as hard; disjoint reliable canonical category evidence is an explicit conflict, while missing/unrecognized category evidence is UNKNOWN and retained
hard_conflict_mask.reliable_evidence: ProductAttributeView values from categories/title/features/details/store or details.* with confidence >=0.90; description text and substring absence are never conflict evidence
hard_conflict_mask.budget: not executable here because visible_context budget_upper does not preserve hard/soft/range provenance; price retrieval or masking would be a second mechanism

explicitly_excluded_variables: raw current-turn retrieval, because it can reintroduce negation and override wrapper text
brand rewrite, because the current dialogue parser does not reliably emit a dedicated brand slot
character n-gram or word n-gram indexes
multiple rewrite routes, RRF, score normalization, learned fusion, reranking, training, embeddings, or LLMs
cross-turn seen exclusion in this diagnostic, because sealed C200 is a pre-P11 candidate trace rather than the v2.12 actual served-page trace

train_explore_proxy.access: first stat/open/hash/read only after two closed candidate traces pass exact-repeat, prefix, source, schema, mask, and resource gates

label_archive.access: one same-handle open after target-free trace gates and proxy join; no inner_fold, training arrays, baseline outcomes, or identifiers

target_free_smoke_protocol.stage_20_sessions: formal interpreter and cwd; direct-script worker and python -m worker on the same first 20 sealed sessions; exact canonical trace bytes/hash and source identities
target_free_smoke_protocol.stage_100_sessions: only after stage 20 passes; direct-script and python -m workers on the same first 100 sealed sessions; exact repeat and resource extrapolation
required_gates: complete variable-C200 is an exact ordered prefix on every turn
C200 loss/reorder/duplicate counts are all zero and C200[:10] is unchanged
tail duplicate count and tail explicit-hard-conflict count are zero
candidate length is between len(C200) and min(400,len(C200)+120)
network attempts and GPU bytes are zero
source/config hashes are unchanged before and after
100-session linear wall extrapolation times 1.5 is within the formal wall budget
target_free_smoke_protocol.failure: PRE_RECEIPT_NO_GO_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKER; no formal receipt and no label/outcome access

device_selection.reason: this experiment is SQLite FTS5 query parsing, branch-heavy hard masking, dedupe, and stable append; the frozen local stack has no semantically equivalent GPU FTS5 backend
device_selection.why_no_gpu_backend_is_added: installing, downloading, changing tokenizer/index semantics, or building a second index is forbidden and would add another experimental variable
device_selection.future_rule: a later dense or training experiment must benchmark the same 100-1000 target-free queries on an idle local GPU and CPU; GPU is selected only with identical candidate/order/hash, exact repeat, <=11GB VRAM, no OOM/NaN, and >=1.5x wall speedup

formal_protocol.preflight_data_input_allowlist: the only experiment-data inputs are the preregistration, tracked implementation, catalog, sealed visible_context, and two sealed C200 references; Python/stdlib/runtime DLLs, Git object reads, nonce-scoped temporary smoke outputs, and the fixed formal receipt parent are runtime infrastructure governed by separate ancestry/type checks rather than experiment-data inputs; recursive external scans are forbidden
formal_protocol.protected_path_deny: before receipt the runner must fail on any stat/open/hash/import/read event under proxy, label, calibration, opened selection, sealed confirmation, released public, Amazon test/heldout, or unrelated experiment result paths
formal_protocol.entrypoints: with D:/450/conda/envs/tiktok/python.exe and repository cwd, runner and worker direct-script plus python -m self-checks must import evaluator.local_evaluator; an intentionally absent required module must fail nonzero without creating a receipt; direct-script is also checked from a non-repository cwd

receipt.creation: prepared real parent, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL, canonical pending marker plus LF and fsync
receipt.existing_state: any existing empty, partial, pending, invalid, or complete receipt permanently forbids another run
receipt.post_receipt_failure: catch BaseException, write only a compact sanitized INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED result through the same descriptor, fsync, close, and never rerun

formal_protocol.workers: two fresh sequential isolated CPU workers, replica A by direct script and replica B by python -m; each streams its trace to a nonce partial file, fsyncs, then publishes exclusively; no Agent.respond or full evaluator is run
formal_protocol.diagnostics: each worker emits one compact enum phase/error_code receipt, sanitized traceback hash, stderr bytes/hash, last completed session, partial trace bytes/hash, P95, RSS, wall, and source hashes; no exception text, identifier, message, target, or per-session result is surfaced
formal_protocol.join: only after both closed traces pass full exact-repeat and all pre-target gates may the parent open the frozen proxy and numeric fold archive and compute anonymous aggregate membership
formal_protocol.result_privacy: no identifiers, targets, messages, per-session values, membership vectors, or arrays of length 2000/20000

candidate_recall_contract.eligibility: a session is recalled at cutoff K iff its target appears in any expanded candidate prefix K at an eligible turn; intent-override eligibility uses the frozen evaluator-side boundary
candidate_recall_contract.primary_expanded_cutoff: C320_COMPLETE_UNION; every turn has at most len(C200)+120 <=320 candidates, so a nominal C400 view would be exactly identical and is not separately selectable
candidate_recall_contract.target_uniform_formula: after receipt only, group the 2000 sessions by exact proxy ground-truth parent_asin without emitting identifiers; for each cluster compute mean session-recall at sealed C200 and at C320_COMPLETE_UNION, then take the unweighted arithmetic mean across unique clusters; report baseline, candidate, and candidate-minus-baseline, and require the delta to be strictly positive
candidate_recall_contract.candidate_loss: structurally zero because the complete C200 is an exact ordered prefix
candidate_recall_contract.forbidden_claim: candidate-recall gain is not served HR, MRR, MTTC, TechnicalScore, private score, or deployment evidence

decision.promotion_gate: all integrity/resource gates pass, C320_COMPLETE_UNION recall is at least 1988/2000, incremental targets span at least two outer folds and at least one non-clothing taxonomy, the frozen exact-target-cluster-uniform C320-minus-C200 delta is strictly positive, exact repeat holds, and tail explicit-hard-conflict count is zero
decision.positive_but_insufficient: one recovered session or gains confined to one fold/single clothing subtype are recorded but do not authorize policy smoke or training
decision.no_go: valid completed probe with expanded recall <=1987 or any promotion-distribution gate failure; freeze this route and preregister the next independent multi-view sparse mechanism without tuning this route
decision.invalid: receipt-time structural/runtime/source/resource failure; implementation failure only, never algorithm No-Go, never rerun
decision.after_promotion: separate preregistered 100-session end-to-end v2.12 paging smoke: first two pages byte-identical per intent version, new tail only at intent-age >=3, real served seen exclusion, h-to-m=0, net>=1, MRR non-regression, MTTC non-regression, TechnicalScore positive, exact repeat
decision.global_promotion: never from this probe; any later 2k policy candidate must strictly exceed HR 0.991 and all global incumbent fold/aggregate safety gates
